feedback_tickets.fullMessage: The barcode scanner crashes when I try to scan a generic oat brand. The camera opens, but right after it recognizes the barcode, the app completely freezes and closes itself.

feedback_tickets.preview: Could you make the recipe font bigger?
feedback_tickets.fullMessage: I love the heart-healthy recipes, but when I am cooking in the kitchen, the font for the ingredients list is very hard to read from a distance. Could you add a text size toggle?
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Assigned to UI team. Planning to add an accessibility slider in the next minor patch.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: I forgot my password, but when I click the reset link in my email, it says the token is invalid or expired. I've tried this three times now.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Known Firebase auth token expiration bug. Sent manual reset link and patched backend token lifespan.

feedback_tickets.preview: Does the CSS score update automatically?
feedback_tickets.fullMessage: If I log my blood pressure today, does my Health Stability Score update right away, or does it take 24 hours?
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Replied via in-app notification confirming real-time updates.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: The exercise guide image stays blank after opening a routine. The loading indicator spins indefinitely and the play button is unresponsive.
The weekly wrap-up is missing one of my logged days. I logged my health parameters on Tuesday, but the summary report shows Tuesday as empty.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Reproduced on exercise history logs. Investigating timezone offsets in reports module.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: One recipe card (Garlic Ginger Stir-Fry) shows the fallback placeholder image instead of the recipe photo. The other recipes load fine.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Issue confirmed and corrected in the latest content configuration CDN link.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: It would be easier to understand sodium and calorie information if the important numbers were emphasized. Right now, all nutrient numbers look identical in font size.

feedback_tickets.preview: Add a clearer exercise completion state...
feedback_tickets.fullMessage: I want to immediately know whether I completed today's routine when looking at the home dashboard. A larger checkmark or distinct color would help.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Assigned to design team to design checkmarks on the circular progress rings.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: The empty activity screen could explain what I should do next. Instead of just saying 'No activity logged today', it could prompt me with a shortcut link to routines.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Updated empty states with quick action buttons to log metrics.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: I changed my account information in settings, but the updated details did not appear immediately in the profile page.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Identified caching issue on the user profile microservice. Added cache-control headers.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: I was logged out during a background refresh and had difficulty returning to the app without resetting my credentials.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Resolved previously and archived after confirmation.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: Can you explain what the HeartLink Health Stability Score represents? I see the numeric score fluctuating but don't know what factors drive it.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Forwarded to support team. Standard HSS calculation guide will be emailed.

feedback_tickets.preview: When should I log a meal?...
feedback_tickets.fullMessage: Should I record meals immediately after eating or later in the day? Does the timing affect the daily sodium limit alerts?
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Confirmed in app instructions that meal logging is real-time but can be logged retroactively without affecting alert limits.

feedback_tickets.fullMessage: Does the app sync with Apple Health or Google Fit? I want my daily steps and heart rate to import automatically.
feedback_tickets.adminNotes: Informed user that health tracker integrations are planned for Phase 3. Closed and archived.
